title: Visualization kind "argumentmap" (argumentkart)
description: Spec for SkeletonVisualization(kind: "argumentmap"). Rendered by CellScaffold web (skeleton-runtime.js) and CellApple (SkeletonView). Layered top-down: conclusions on the first row, each node below the node it points to. The renderer never infers relations; it draws what the cell sends.

legend.description: Short explanation shown above the map.

body.description: Short paraphrase or quote, renderer truncates to 3 lines.

label.description: Shown on the edge; defaults to the Norwegian relation name.

inferred.description: Dashed and grey; e.g. heuristic or model proposal not yet accepted.

x-action: Tapping a node sends {"selectedID": <id>} to actionKeypath; stateKeypath holds the selection. Same contract as kind network.
x-limits: Cycles are drawn as upward edges without changing rows. Unknown role/relation falls back to premise/context. Empty nodes shows «Ingen påstander ennå».
